passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Cascade Cloud Billing Team,

I am writing about invoice #77410, which lists a charge of $1,240 for the Enterprise Analytics add-on. Our records show that we downgraded to the Standard plan on February 1, and the add-on should have been removed from our account at that time.

This is the second month in a row that our invoice has not reflected the downgrade, and the extra charge has already been deducted from our account. Could you please issue a corrected invoice and refund the overcharged amount as soon as possible?
We value our partnership with Cascade Cloud and would like to resolve this quickly so it does not affect next month's billing cycle.

Sincerely,
Marcus Whitfield
Accounts Payable, Driftwood Retail Group

questions.question_en: Why did Mr. Whitfield write the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 惠特菲爾德先生為什麼撰寫這封電子郵件?
options: To dispute an incorrect charge on an invoice
To request a copy of a contract
To ask about upgrading to a premium plan
questions.explanation_zh: 信中說明公司已於2月1日降級方案，但發票仍列出應被移除的附加功能費用，並要求更正發票與退款，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: According to the e-mail, when did Driftwood Retail Group downgrade its plan?
questions.question_zh: 根據這封電子郵件，Driftwood Retail Group 是何時將方案降級的?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到公司已於2月1日(February 1)降級為標準方案，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about Driftwood Retail Group's relationship with Cascade Cloud Systems?
questions.question_zh: 從信中可以推論出 Driftwood Retail Group 與 Cascade Cloud Systems 之間的關係為何?
options: It plans to end its contract with Cascade Cloud
It intends to continue doing business with Cascade Cloud
It has never been billed correctly
It is switching to a competitor next month
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到「我們重視與 Cascade Cloud 的合作關係，希望盡快解決此事」，顯示雙方仍打算繼續合作，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "deducted" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第三段中的 "deducted" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: 此處 "deducted" 指金額已從帳戶中「被扣除」，與 "subtracted"（被扣除、被減去）意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Memo
paragraphs: This memo announces a new benefit for employees who work remotely at least three days per week.

Beginning June 1, eligible employees may request reimbursement of up to $300 per calendar year for home-office equipment, including desks, chairs, and monitors. Receipts must be submitted through the expense portal within 60 days of purchase.

Employees who are unsure whether they qualify should check their work arrangement status with their manager before submitting a claim, since the stipend does not apply to staff who work remotely fewer than three days per week.
Questions about the program can be directed to the Human Resources office.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the memo?
questions.question_zh: 這份備忘錄的目的為何?
options: To announce a new home-office equipment benefit
To request receipts for past purchases
To introduce a new performance review process
questions.explanation_zh: 備忘錄開頭即說明要宣布一項新的居家辦公設備補助福利，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the memo, what is the maximum annual reimbursement amount?
questions.question_zh: 根據備忘錄，每年最高可申請多少補助金額?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段明確指出每年最高可補助 $300，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Who is NOT eligible for the stipend?
questions.question_zh: 下列何者「不」符合申請此項補助的資格?
options: Employees who work remotely five days per week
Employees who work remotely three days per week
Employees who work remotely fewer than three days per week
Employees who submit receipts within 60 days
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段說明此補助不適用於每週遠距工作少於三天的員工，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: The word "eligible" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "eligible" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "eligible" 意指「符合資格的」，與 "qualified" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Letter

meta.label: From:
meta.value: Helena Voss, Development Director, Ashcombe Museum of Natural History

meta.label: To:
meta.value: Mr. Dennis Okafor, CEO, Okafor & Bright Financial Group

paragraphs: Dear Mr. Okafor,

On behalf of everyone at the Ashcombe Museum of Natural History, thank you for renewing your company's sponsorship of our Discovery Hall exhibit for another two years. Your continued support allows us to keep admission free for local schoolchildren.

As a sponsor at the Platinum level, Okafor & Bright Financial Group will receive prominent signage at the Discovery Hall entrance, four passes to our annual gala, and recognition in our spring newsletter, which reaches more than twelve thousand households.
We are also pleased to invite you to a private preview of our upcoming dinosaur fossil exhibit on October 14, before it opens to the public.

With gratitude,
Helena Voss
Development Director

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of the letter?
questions.question_zh: 這封信的主要目的為何?
options: To thank a company for renewing its sponsorship
To announce the closing of an exhibit
To apply for a museum grant
questions.explanation_zh: 信件一開始即感謝對方公司續約贊助探索廳展覽，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: According to the letter, how many gala passes will Okafor & Bright Financial Group receive?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，Okafor & Bright Financial Group 將獲得幾張晚宴入場券?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到白金等級贊助商可獲得四張年度晚宴入場券，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will most likely happen on October 14?
questions.question_zh: 10月14日最有可能會發生什麼事?
options: The newsletter will be mailed to households
Mr. Okafor will attend a private preview of a new exhibit
The museum will open a new gift shop
questions.explanation_zh: 第四段提到10月14日將邀請對方參加恐龍化石展的私人預覽，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "prominent" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第三段中的 "prominent" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "prominent signage" 指「醒目、顯眼的標示」，與 "noticeable" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: E-mail

meta.label: Subject:
meta.value: Re: Warranty Claim - VeloCore Trail 5 Frame Crack

paragraphs: Dear Ms. Hendricks,

Thank you for sending the photographs of the crack near the seat post on your VeloCore Trail 5. After reviewing the images and your proof of purchase, we have confirmed that the frame is covered under our five-year manufacturer's warranty.

We will ship a replacement frame to the address on file within seven to ten business days at no cost to you. Please bring the bicycle to any authorized VeloCore dealer once the new frame arrives so a technician can transfer the components and complete the reassembly.
If you do not have an authorized dealer nearby, our customer service line can help arrange for a mobile mechanic to visit you instead.

Best regards,
Customer Support Team, VeloCore Bikes

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 這封電子郵件的主要目的為何?
options: To inform a customer that a warranty claim has been approved
To ask a customer to pay for a repair
questions.explanation_zh: 信中確認車架裂痕在五年保固範圍內，並說明將寄送替換車架，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: According to the e-mail, how long will it take to ship the replacement frame?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，寄送替換車架大約需要多久時間?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到替換車架將在七到十個工作天內寄出，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is Ms. Hendricks instructed to do once the new frame arrives?
questions.question_zh: 當新車架送達後，韓翠克斯女士被要求做什麼?
options: Return the old frame by mail
Bring the bicycle to an authorized dealer
Contact the manufacturer for a refund instead
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段說明新車架送達後，應將腳踏車送至授權經銷商由技師組裝，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "authorized" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第三段中的 "authorized" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "authorized dealer" 指「經官方核准的經銷商」，與 "officially approved" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: E-mail

meta.label: Subject:
meta.value: Your Campus Tour Has Been Moved

paragraphs: Dear Ms. Park,

We are writing to let you know that your scheduled campus tour on November 4 has been moved to November 6 at 10:00 a.m. because of a facilities inspection that will restrict access to several buildings on our original date.

The tour will still begin at the Admissions Welcome Center and will include visits to the science labs, the student residence halls, and the newly renovated library. A member of our admissions team will also be available afterward to answer any questions about financial aid.
If November 6 does not work with your schedule, please reply to this e-mail and we will be happy to arrange another date.
We look forward to welcoming you to Brindlewood College.

questions.question_en: Why was the e-mail sent to Ms. Park?
questions.question_zh: 這封電子郵件為什麼會寄給朴女士?
options: To confirm her admission to the college
To notify her of a change to her campus tour
To request her financial aid documents
To invite her to a graduation ceremony
questions.explanation_zh: 信件說明她原訂的校園參觀時間已更改，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: When was the tour originally scheduled to take place?
questions.question_zh: 這場參觀活動原本排定於何時舉行?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到原訂日期為11月4日，因設施檢查而改期，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What should Ms. Park do if the new date is inconvenient for her?
questions.question_zh: 如果新的日期對朴女士不方便，她應該怎麼做?
options: Visit the campus on her own
Reply to the e-mail to arrange another date
Contact the financial aid office directly
questions.explanation_zh: 第四段提到若11月6日不方便，可回覆此信另約時間，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: The word "restrict" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "restrict" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "restrict access" 指「限制進出」，與 "limit" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Colleagues,
As part of our transition to a new client-management platform, the internal network and e-mail system will be unavailable from 11:00 p.m. Friday, November 14, until 6:00 a.m. Monday, November 17.

During this window, employees will not be able to access shared drives, the client database, or company e-mail from any device, including personal phones connected to the corporate account. Please save any documents you need for Monday morning before you leave the office on Friday.
If a client emergency arises over the weekend, contact the IT help desk directly at the emergency line posted on the intranet home page.
We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience while we complete this upgrade.

questions.question_en: Why was this e-mail sent to all staff?
questions.question_zh: 這封電子郵件為什麼會發送給全體員工?
options: To announce a new company holiday
To inform staff of a scheduled network outage
To request feedback on a new software platform
To cancel all weekend client meetings
questions.explanation_zh: 信中說明因系統升級，網路與電子郵件系統將於週末暫停服務，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: According to the e-mail, when will the network outage end?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，這次網路中斷何時結束?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到系統將於11月17日星期一上午6點恢復，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What are employees advised to do before leaving the office on Friday?
questions.question_zh: 員工在週五離開辦公室前被建議做什麼?
options: Save documents needed for Monday morning
Submit a report to the IT help desk
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段建議員工在離開前先儲存週一上午需要用到的文件，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "unavailable" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "unavailable" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "unavailable" 指系統「無法使用、無法連線」，與 "inaccessible" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Letter

meta.label: From:
meta.value: Rosalind Kemp, Property Manager, Bellhaven Property Management

meta.label: To:
meta.value: Mr. Andre Silva, Unit 4B, Bellhaven Court Apartments

paragraphs: Dear Mr. Silva,
Your current lease for Unit 4B at Bellhaven Court Apartments is due to expire on August 31. We would like to offer you the opportunity to renew for an additional twelve months.

Due to increased property taxes and maintenance costs, the monthly rent for a renewed lease will be $1,450, an increase of $75 over your current rate. All other lease terms, including the assigned parking space, will remain unchanged.

If you would like to renew, please sign and return the enclosed renewal agreement by July 15. If we do not receive a response by that date, we will assume you do not intend to renew and will begin advertising the unit for new applicants.

Sincerely,
Rosalind Kemp
Property Manager

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of the letter?
questions.question_zh: 這封信的主要目的為何?
options: To notify a tenant of an eviction
To offer a tenant the option to renew a lease at a new rate
questions.explanation_zh: 信中說明租約即將到期，並提供以新租金續租的機會，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: According to the letter, what will the new monthly rent be?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，新的每月租金將是多少?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到續約後的每月租金為 $1,450，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will happen if Mr. Silva does not respond by July 15?
questions.question_zh: 如果席爾瓦先生在7月15日前沒有回覆，將會發生什麼事?
options: The unit will be advertised to new applicants
He will lose his parking space immediately
questions.explanation_zh: 第四段說明若未在期限前回覆，管理公司將視為不續約並開始對外招租，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "enclosed" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第四段中的 "enclosed" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "enclosed" 指信件中「隨附、附上」的文件，與 "included" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Meadowbrook Textiles Sales Team,

We noticed that several fabric patterns listed on your website, including the Harvest Plaid and Coastal Stripe lines, are no longer showing up in the catalog you sent us last October. Could you confirm whether these patterns have been discontinued?

We would like to place a spring reorder soon and want to be sure we are working from your most current product list and pricing before we finalize our order. If possible, please send an updated catalog with your latest wholesale prices by February 5.
We have enjoyed working with Meadowbrook Textiles for the past three years and hope to continue our partnership with the new season's order.

Best regards,
Olivia Chen
Purchasing Manager, Thimble & Thread

questions.question_en: Why did Ms. Chen write the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 陳女士為什麼撰寫這封電子郵件?
options: To request an updated catalog before placing an order
To complain about a late delivery
To apply for a wholesale account
questions.explanation_zh: 信中詢問特定花色是否停產，並要求在下訂前取得最新型錄與報價，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the e-mail, by when would Ms. Chen like to receive the updated catalog?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，陳女士希望在何時之前收到更新後的型錄?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到希望在2月5日前收到最新型錄與報價，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about the relationship between Thimble & Thread and Meadowbrook Textiles?
questions.question_zh: 從信中可以推論出 Thimble & Thread 與 Meadowbrook Textiles 之間的關係為何?
options: They have worked together for three years
They have never done business before
questions.explanation_zh: 第四段提到雙方已合作三年，並希望繼續合作，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "discontinued" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "discontinued" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "discontinued" 指產品「已停止生產」，與 "no longer produced" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: Ironclad Fitness Studio — New Year, New Member Special

Join Ironclad Fitness Studio before January 31 and pay no enrollment fee, a savings of $99. New members also receive a complimentary session with one of our certified personal trainers to help design a workout plan suited to their goals.

Our downtown location features a full weight room, twenty group fitness classes per week, and a heated indoor pool. Members with an annual plan can also reserve the private training studio for four hours per month at no extra charge.
Monthly memberships start at $45, or save 15 percent by choosing an annual plan. Stop by our front desk at 210 Harmon Street or visit ironcladfitness-example.com to sign up.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的主要目的為何?
options: To promote a new membership special
To advertise a job opening for a trainer
To recruit volunteers for a charity event
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告內容在宣傳健身房限時的新會員優惠方案，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, what do new members receive at no extra cost?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，新會員可免費獲得什麼?
options: A free session with a personal trainer
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到新會員可獲得一次免費的私人教練課程，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: Who is able to reserve the private training studio at no extra charge?
questions.question_zh: 誰可以免費預約私人訓練室?
options: Members who pay the enrollment fee
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到擁有年繳方案的會員每月可免費使用私人訓練室四小時，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "complimentary" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "complimentary" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "complimentary session" 指「免費贈送的課程」，與 "free of charge" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Job Posting
paragraphs: Meridian Software Solutions is looking for a detail-oriented Quality Assurance Tester to join our growing product team.

The successful candidate will design and execute test cases for new application features, document software defects, and work closely with developers to verify that fixes resolve reported issues before each release.

Candidates should have at least two years of experience in software testing, familiarity with bug-tracking tools such as Jira, and a working knowledge of basic SQL queries. Experience with automated testing tools is preferred but not required.

This is a full-time, on-site position with a starting salary range of $58,000 to $68,000, depending on experience. Interested candidates should send a resume and cover letter to careers@meridiansoftware-example.com by March 20.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的主要目的為何?
options: To announce a new software release
To recruit customers for a beta test
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告內容在說明公司正在招募品質保證測試人員的職缺，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, how many years of testing experience are required?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，應徵者至少需要幾年的測試經驗?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到應徵者須具備至少兩年的軟體測試經驗，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What is suggested about experience with automated testing tools?
questions.question_zh: 關於自動化測試工具的經驗，廣告中暗示了什麼?
options: It is mandatory for all applicants
It is preferred but not required
It is only needed for senior positions
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到具備自動化測試工具經驗為加分項目，但非必要條件，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "verify" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "verify" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "verify that fixes resolve reported issues" 指「確認」修復是否有效，與 "confirm" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: Foothill Harvest Food & Wine Festival — October 10-11

Now in its eighth year, the Foothill Harvest Food & Wine Festival brings together more than sixty regional restaurants, wineries, and craft breweries for a weekend celebration of local flavor at Foothill Park.

This year's festival will feature cooking demonstrations from three award-winning chefs, a farmers' market pavilion, and live music each evening. A limited number of VIP passes include early entry, a reserved seating area, and a private tasting session with festival vendors.

General admission tickets are $25 in advance or $35 at the gate; children under twelve are admitted free. VIP passes are $95 and are expected to sell out, so early purchase is recommended. Tickets are available at foothillharvestfest-example.com.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的目的為何?
options: To promote a food and wine festival
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告內容在宣傳一場美食美酒節，並提供票價資訊，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, how much does a VIP pass cost?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，VIP通行證的價格為多少?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到VIP通行證的價格為 $95，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: Why does the advertisement recommend purchasing VIP passes early?
questions.question_zh: 廣告為什麼建議提早購買VIP通行證?
options: The passes are expected to sell out
Only online orders are accepted after the festival begins
VIP passes are only sold at the gate
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到VIP通行證數量有限，預期將會售罄，因此建議提早購買，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "feature" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第三段中的 "feature" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: 此處 "feature" 作動詞，指活動「包含、以...為特色」，與 "include" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: Retail Space for Lease — Copperfield Marketplace
A 1,200-square-foot storefront is now available for lease at Copperfield Marketplace, a busy shopping center located at the corner of Delacroix Avenue and Ninth Street.

The space was most recently occupied by a boutique clothing store and includes a large display window, a small stockroom, and a shared loading dock at the rear of the building. The unit is situated between a popular bakery and a pet supply shop, both of which draw steady foot traffic throughout the week.
Rent is $3,200 per month, including common area maintenance fees. Interested tenants should contact the leasing office to schedule a walkthrough before the space is listed publicly next month.

questions.question_en: What is being advertised?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告在宣傳什麼?
options: A retail space available for lease
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告開頭即說明有一處零售空間可供出租，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, what is the size of the available space?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，這個可租用空間的坪數大小為何?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到該店面面積為1,200平方英尺，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about foot traffic near the available space?
questions.question_zh: 從廣告中可以推論出該空間附近的人潮狀況為何?
options: It is generally low throughout the year
It is likely to be strong due to nearby businesses
It has declined since the clothing store closed
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到該空間位於人氣麵包店與寵物用品店之間，兩者皆帶來穩定人潮，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "situated" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第三段中的 "situated" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "situated between" 指「位於...之間」，與 "located" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: ClearView Home Security — See Everything, Anywhere
The new ClearView 360 outdoor camera delivers crisp 4K video, night vision up to 30 meters, and two-way audio so you can speak with visitors directly from your phone.

Unlike many competing models, the ClearView 360 requires no monthly subscription for the first year; recorded footage is stored locally on an included memory card. After the first year, customers may choose to add cloud storage for $4.99 a month.
Order by August 15 and receive a free outdoor mounting kit, a $20 value. Visit clearviewhome-example.com or your nearest Bramwell Electronics store to learn more.

questions.question_en: What is being advertised?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告在宣傳什麼產品?
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告內容在介紹一款戶外居家安全攝影機的功能與優惠，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, how far can the camera's night vision reach?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，這款攝影機的夜視距離可達多遠?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到夜視距離可達30公尺，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What is implied about many competing camera models?
questions.question_zh: 廣告暗示許多競爭品牌的攝影機產品有什麼特點?
options: They do not offer night vision
They are more expensive to purchase
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到「與許多競爭機型不同」，該產品第一年不需訂閱月費，暗示其他品牌多半需要月費，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: The word "crisp" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "crisp" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "crisp 4K video" 指「清晰銳利的畫質」，與 "clear" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Job Posting
paragraphs: Willowmere Animal Hospital is seeking a licensed Veterinary Technician to join our busy small-animal practice.
Responsibilities include assisting veterinarians during examinations and surgeries, administering medications, taking X-rays, and educating pet owners on post-operative care.

Applicants must hold a current veterinary technician license and have at least one year of clinical experience; experience with dental cleanings is a plus. This position requires occasional Saturday shifts.

We offer a starting wage of $22 to $26 per hour, health insurance, and a discount on veterinary services for employees' own pets. To apply, submit an application through our website at willowmereanimal-example.com.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的目的為何?
options: To advertise a job opening for a veterinary technician
To promote a new pet insurance plan
To announce the hospital's grand opening
To recruit volunteers for animal rescue
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告內容在說明動物醫院正在招募合格的獸醫技術員，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, what is required of all applicants?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，所有應徵者都必須具備什麼條件?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到應徵者必須持有現行的獸醫技術員執照，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about the work schedule for this position?
questions.question_zh: 從廣告中可以推論出這份工作的排班方式為何?
options: It sometimes requires working on Saturdays
It is a part-time position only
It requires working overnight every day
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到此職位須不定期於週六排班，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "administering" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "administering" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "administering medications" 指「給予、施予藥物」，與 "giving" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: Pemberton Books Closing-Down Clearance Sale

After eighteen years serving the Pemberton neighborhood, Pemberton Books will permanently close its doors on November 30. Everything in the store, including new releases, rare first editions, and gift items, is now discounted.

Discounts begin at 30 percent off and will increase each week as the closing date approaches, reaching up to 70 percent off during the final week. Store shelving, reading chairs, and display cases are also for sale.
The store will remain open seven days a week until closing. Store credit and gift cards must be used by November 25; no refunds will be issued after that date.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的目的為何?
options: To announce a store's closing sale
To promote a new book release
To advertise a store's grand opening
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告內容在宣布書店即將永久歇業並進行清倉特賣，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, what is the maximum discount available?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，最高的折扣為多少?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到最後一週折扣最高可達70%，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred from the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 從這則廣告可以推論出什麼?
options: Discounts will be the same every week
Customers who wait longer to shop may get better discounts
The store will reopen at a new location
Gift cards can be used indefinitely
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到折扣會隨著歇業日期接近而逐週提高，因此越晚採購折扣可能越高，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "permanently" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "permanently" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "permanently close" 指「永久性地關閉」，與 "forever" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Notice
paragraphs: This notice is to inform all tenants of the Kingsley Office Tower that the north elevator bank (elevators 1 through 3) will be out of service for scheduled maintenance from March 8 through March 10.

During this period, tenants and visitors should use the south elevator bank or the stairwell located near the main lobby. Building management recommends allowing extra time when traveling to and from upper floors, particularly during peak morning and evening hours.
Deliveries requiring elevator access, including furniture and heavy equipment, should be scheduled for after 6:00 p.m. and coordinated with the building's front desk in advance.
We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your patience while we complete this necessary upgrade.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告的目的為何?
options: To inform tenants of elevator maintenance
To announce a new tenant move-in
To introduce a new front desk policy
To advertise office space for lease
questions.explanation_zh: 公告開頭即說明北側電梯將進行例行維護保養，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the notice, from when to when will the north elevators be out of service?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告內容，北側電梯將於何時停止使用?
questions.explanation_zh: 第一段提到北側電梯將於3月8日至3月10日停止使用，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What should someone do to deliver heavy equipment during this period?
questions.question_zh: 在這段期間，若要運送重型設備應該怎麼做?
options: Use the south elevator bank only
Schedule it after 6:00 p.m. with the front desk
Carry it up the stairwell instead
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到運送重型設備應安排在晚上6點後，並事先與櫃檯協調，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "peak" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "peak" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "peak morning and evening hours" 指「最繁忙的尖峰時段」，與 "busiest" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Notice
paragraphs: Please be advised that the west parking garage at Fairview Medical Center will be closed for structural repairs beginning July 15 and continuing through approximately August 5.

Patients and visitors should use the east parking garage or the surface lot on Redwood Avenue during this time. A free shuttle will run every fifteen minutes between the east garage and the main hospital entrance.

Employees who normally park in the west garage will be reassigned temporary spaces in the surface lot; parking permits will not need to be replaced, as garage access gates will accept the same permit at the alternate location.
Questions about parking arrangements during the closure should be directed to Hospital Facilities Management.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告的目的為何?
options: To announce new hospital visiting hours
To inform readers of a parking garage closure
To advertise a new shuttle service company
To request donations for hospital repairs
questions.explanation_zh: 公告說明西側停車場將因結構維修而暫時關閉，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: According to the notice, how often will the shuttle run?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告內容，接駁車多久發車一次?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到接駁車每15分鐘發車一次，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is true about employees' parking permits during the closure?
questions.question_zh: 在停車場關閉期間，員工的停車許可證狀況為何?
options: They must be replaced with new permits
They will still work at the alternate location
They must be returned to Facilities Management
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到員工的許可證不需更換，仍可在替代地點的門禁使用，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "reassigned" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第三段中的 "reassigned" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "reassigned temporary spaces" 指員工被「重新分配」到臨時車位，與 "given new" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Press Release
paragraphs: Bramwell Robotics Secures $40 Million in Series C Funding
Bramwell Robotics, a maker of automated inventory-scanning drones for warehouses, announced today that it has raised $40 million in Series C funding led by Highcastle Ventures.

The company plans to use the funding to triple the size of its engineering team and expand manufacturing of its flagship drone, the ScanHawk, which is currently used in more than 200 distribution centers across North America.

"This investment allows us to meet growing demand from retailers who want faster, more accurate inventory counts," said Bramwell Robotics co-founder and CEO Talia Osei. The company expects to open a second manufacturing facility in Ohio by next spring.
Bramwell Robotics was founded five years ago and has raised a total of $68 million to date.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the press release?
questions.question_zh: 這則新聞稿的目的為何?
options: To announce a company's new funding round
To announce a merger between two companies
questions.explanation_zh: 新聞稿主要在宣布公司完成一輪新的募資，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the press release, how much funding did Bramwell Robotics raise in this round?
questions.question_zh: 根據新聞稿內容，Bramwell Robotics 在這一輪募資中籌得多少資金?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到公司在本輪募資中籌得4,000萬美元，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What does the company plan to do with the new funding?
questions.question_zh: 公司計劃如何運用這筆新的資金?
options: Expand its engineering team and manufacturing capacity
Reduce the number of distribution centers it serves
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到資金將用於擴大工程團隊並增加旗艦產品的產能，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "flagship" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "flagship" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "flagship drone" 指公司「主力、旗艦級」的產品，與 "leading" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Public Notice
paragraphs: Public Notice: Overlook Bridge to Close for Repainting

The Department of Transportation announces that Overlook Bridge, connecting Route 9 and Meridian Road, will be closed to all vehicle traffic from 9:00 p.m. on Friday, September 11, through 5:00 a.m. on Monday, September 14, for repainting and structural inspection.

Drivers should use the detour route via Route 9 to Harmon Parkway to Meridian Road, which adds approximately eight minutes to the normal travel time. Pedestrian and bicycle access across the bridge will remain open throughout the closure.
The closure was originally scheduled for August but was postponed due to weather conditions. Officials note that further delays are possible if heavy rain returns before or during the scheduled work.
Updates will be posted on the Department of Transportation's website and social media accounts.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this public notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告的目的為何?
options: To inform the public of a bridge closure
To announce a new speed limit
To request public comments on a construction project
To announce the opening of a new bridge
questions.explanation_zh: 公告主要在告知民眾一座橋樑將因重新粉刷及結構檢查而封閉，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the notice, who may still cross the bridge during the closure?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告內容，在封閉期間誰仍可通過該橋樑?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到行人與自行車在封閉期間仍可通行，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why was the closure originally postponed?
questions.question_zh: 這次封閉工程原本為什麼被延後?
options: Due to a lack of funding
Due to a scheduling conflict with another project
Due to a shortage of workers
questions.explanation_zh: 第四段提到工程原訂於8月進行，因天候因素而延後，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "postponed" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第四段中的 "postponed" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "postponed" 意指「延後」，與 "delayed" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Company Announcement
paragraphs: Halcyon Freight Appoints New Chief Financial Officer

Halcyon Freight Corporation announced today that Vivian Marsh will become the company's new Chief Financial Officer, effective November 1, succeeding Gerald Boone, who is retiring after eleven years in the role.
Ms. Marsh joins Halcyon Freight from Continental Rail Systems, where she served as Vice President of Finance for six years and led the company's transition to a new financial reporting system.

"Vivian's experience in the logistics industry and her track record of improving financial operations make her an excellent fit for Halcyon Freight as we continue to expand our regional routes," said CEO Daniel Voss.
Mr. Boone will remain with the company in an advisory capacity through the end of the year to ensure a smooth transition.

questions.question_en: What is the announcement mainly about?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告主要在說明什麼?
questions.explanation_zh: 公告主要在宣布公司任命新任財務長，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the announcement, when will Ms. Marsh's appointment take effect?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告內容，馬許女士何時正式上任?
options: At the end of the year
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到她將於11月1日正式生效上任，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will Mr. Boone do after November 1?
questions.question_zh: 波恩先生在11月1日之後將會做什麼?
options: Remain in an advisory role through the end of the year
questions.explanation_zh: 第四段提到波恩先生將以顧問身分留任至年底，協助交接，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "succeeding" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第一段中的 "succeeding" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "succeeding Gerald Boone" 指「接替」波恩先生的職位，與 "replacing" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Notice
paragraphs: Effective March 1, all visitors to Thornwell Business Center will be required to sign in electronically at the lobby kiosk and display a printed or digital visitor badge at all times while in the building.

This change replaces the paper sign-in sheet previously kept at the security desk. Visitors will need to provide a valid photo ID, which will be scanned and returned immediately; no identification will be retained by building security.
Tenants are asked to notify the front desk at least fifteen minutes before a visitor's scheduled arrival so that a badge can be prepared in advance and delays at check-in can be minimized.
Employees of tenant companies will continue to use their existing key-card access and are not affected by this change.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告的目的為何?
options: To inform readers of a new visitor sign-in policy
To introduce a new security company
To request tenants to update their key cards
questions.explanation_zh: 公告主要在說明新的訪客電子簽到制度即將實施，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the notice, what must visitors provide at the kiosk?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告內容，訪客在電子櫃檯必須出示什麼?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到訪客須出示有效的附照片證件供掃描，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Who is NOT affected by this change?
questions.question_zh: 下列何者「不會」受到此項變更影響?
questions.explanation_zh: 第四段提到租戶員工仍使用原有的門禁卡，不受此變更影響，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: The word "retained" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "retained" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "no identification will be retained" 指證件不會被「留存、保留」，與 "kept" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Press Release
paragraphs: Cobalt Hardware to Open Fifth Location in Millbrook Saturday
Cobalt Hardware will celebrate the grand opening of its fifth store location, at 88 Milltown Road in Millbrook, this Saturday, September 19, at 9:00 a.m.
The 15,000-square-foot store will carry the company's full range of tools, lumber, and gardening supplies, along with a new paint-mixing station and an expanded rental department for power equipment.

The first 100 customers through the door on opening day will receive a free tote bag filled with sample products, and all customers can enter a raffle for a $500 shopping spree. Local landscaping company Green Acres Design will also be on-site offering free garden consultations.
Cobalt Hardware was founded eighteen years ago in Millbrook and now operates stores in four other towns across the region.

questions.question_en: What is the press release mainly about?
questions.question_zh: 這則新聞稿主要在說明什麼?
options: The grand opening of a new store location
The closing of a hardware store
A change in store operating hours
questions.explanation_zh: 新聞稿主要在宣布五金行第五家分店即將盛大開幕，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the press release, what will the first 100 customers receive?
questions.question_zh: 根據新聞稿內容，前100名顧客可以獲得什麼?
options: A free tote bag with sample products
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到前100名進店的顧客將獲得裝有樣品的免費托特包，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about Cobalt Hardware?
questions.question_zh: 從新聞稿中可以推論出關於 Cobalt Hardware 的什麼訊息?
options: It has struggled to grow since it was founded
It has expanded from its original location over time
It plans to close its original store
questions.explanation_zh: 第四段提到公司18年前創立於Millbrook，如今已在其他四個城鎮設有分店，顯示逐漸擴張，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "expanded" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "expanded" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "expanded rental department" 指「擴大後的」租賃部門，與 "enlarged" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Notice
paragraphs: The Ashford Public Library will operate on a reduced schedule beginning April 21 while the second-floor reading rooms undergo renovation.

During the renovation, which is expected to last through mid-June, the library will be open Tuesday through Saturday from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. and will remain closed on Sundays and Mondays. The children's section and computer lab on the first floor will remain open during regular hours throughout the project.
Patrons with items on hold will still be able to pick them up at the first-floor circulation desk. Book drop returns will not be affected and will continue to be collected daily.
The library apologizes for any inconvenience and looks forward to unveiling the newly renovated reading rooms this summer.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告的目的為何?
options: To inform patrons of temporarily reduced library hours
To announce the library's permanent closing
To introduce new library membership cards
To request donations for a renovation project
questions.explanation_zh: 公告說明因二樓閱覽室整修，圖書館將暫時縮短開放時間，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the notice, on which days will the library be closed?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告內容，圖書館在哪些日子將休館?
options: The library will not close at all
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到圖書館將於週日及週一休館，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will NOT be affected by the renovation?
questions.question_zh: 下列何者「不會」受到整修工程影響?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到還書箱的收件服務不受影響，仍照常每日收取，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "unveiling" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第四段中的 "unveiling" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "unveiling the newly renovated reading rooms" 指「揭曉、公開展示」整修後的空間，與 "revealing" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Invoice
paragraphs: Please find below the itemized charges for office supply order #45213, shipped on June 17 by Union Square Office Supply. Payment is due within 15 days of the invoice date.

Items: 10 boxes of letter-size copy paper ($42.00), 25 black ink cartridges ($375.00), 5 ergonomic keyboard trays ($260.00), and 1 heavy-duty paper shredder ($189.00). Subtotal: $866.00. Shipping fee: $24.00. Total due: $890.00.
A late fee of 1.5 percent per month will be applied to any unpaid balance after the due date. Please remit payment by check or bank transfer using the account information provided on our website.
For questions about this invoice, contact our billing department at billing@unionsquareoffice-example.com.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this document?

options: To bill a client for supplies that were ordered
To request a refund for damaged goods
To confirm a change in delivery address
To apply for a new business account
questions.explanation_zh: 文件內容為列出訂單品項並向客戶請款，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the invoice, what is the total amount due?
questions.question_zh: 根據發票內容，應付總金額為多少?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到含運費在內，應付總金額為 $890.00，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: What will happen if the balance is not paid by the due date?
questions.question_zh: 如果未在到期日前付清款項，將會發生什麼事?
options: A late fee of 1.5 percent per month will apply
The account will be closed immediately
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到逾期未付將按月加收1.5%的滯納金，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "remit" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第三段中的 "remit" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "remit payment" 指「寄送、繳納」款項，與 "send" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Registration Form
paragraphs: Complete the form below to register for the Effective Leadership Workshop Series. Registration includes all workshop materials, a working lunch each day, and a certificate of completion.

Two tracks are offered: the New Manager Track, designed for employees who have supervised staff for fewer than two years, and the Senior Leader Track, designed for department heads and directors. Participants should select only one track.

The registration fee is $175 for the New Manager Track and $225 for the Senior Leader Track. Group discounts of 10 percent are available for organizations registering four or more employees at the same time.
Space is limited to 40 participants per track. Registrations received after September 25 will be added to a waiting list.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this form?
questions.question_zh: 這份表格的目的為何?
options: To register participants for a leadership workshop
To apply for a management position
To evaluate a completed training program
To request a refund for a canceled workshop
questions.explanation_zh: 表格內容用於報名參加領導力工作坊系列課程，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the form, how much is the registration fee for the Senior Leader Track?
questions.question_zh: 根據表格內容，資深領導者組別的報名費為多少?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到資深領導者組別的報名費為 $225，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Who should register for the New Manager Track?
questions.question_zh: 什麼樣的人應該報名新任主管組別?
options: Employees who have supervised staff for fewer than two years
Anyone registering four or more people
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到新任主管組別適合督導年資少於兩年的員工，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: The word "limited" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第四段中的 "limited" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "space is limited" 指名額「受到限制」，與 "restricted" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Order Confirmation
paragraphs: Thank you for your order. Because several of the tablets you ordered are currently on backorder from the manufacturer, your order will be shipped in two separate batches rather than as a single delivery.

The first batch, containing 40 laptop carts and 100 protective tablet cases, will ship by February 14. The second batch, containing 150 classroom tablets, is expected to ship by March 3 once the manufacturer's supply is replenished.

You will not be charged for either batch until it ships, and shipping charges will be waived for the second batch since the delay was on our end. A tracking number will be e-mailed to you as each batch leaves our warehouse.
If you have any questions about this order, please contact your sales representative directly.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this document?
questions.question_zh: 這份文件的目的為何?
options: To confirm order details and explain a split shipment
To apologize for a billing error
questions.explanation_zh: 文件說明訂單將分兩批出貨的原因與時程，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the confirmation, when is the second batch expected to ship?
questions.question_zh: 根據訂單確認內容，第二批貨物預計何時出貨?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到第二批商品預計於3月3日出貨，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Why will shipping charges be waived for the second batch?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼第二批貨物的運費將被免除?
options: The delay was the seller's responsibility
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到因延遲責任在賣方，因此第二批運費將被免除，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "replenished" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "replenished" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "once the manufacturer's supply is replenished" 指供應「重新補足」，與 "restocked" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Membership Application
paragraphs: Complete this application to apply for membership at Junction Coworking Hub. New members must provide a valid government-issued ID and proof of a registered business or freelance activity.

Three membership levels are available: Hot Desk ($150/month, any open seating), Dedicated Desk ($275/month, a reserved desk in a shared room), and Private Office ($650/month, a lockable private office for up to three people). All levels include high-speed internet, printing credits, and access to conference rooms by reservation.

Members may upgrade or downgrade their membership level once per quarter by submitting a change request at least ten business days before their next billing date. A one-time key fob deposit of $25 applies to all levels and is refundable when the fob is returned.
Completed applications are typically processed within three business days. Approved applicants will receive a welcome e-mail with move-in instructions.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this form?
questions.question_zh: 這份表格的目的為何?
options: To apply for membership at a coworking space
To reserve a conference room for a single meeting
To request a refund of a key fob deposit
questions.explanation_zh: 表格用於申請共享辦公空間的會員資格，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the form, how much does a Dedicated Desk membership cost per month?
questions.question_zh: 根據表格內容，專屬桌位會員的月費為多少?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到專屬桌位會員的月費為 $275，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What must a member do to change membership levels?
questions.question_zh: 會員若想變更會員等級，必須怎麼做?
options: Submit a change request at least ten business days before the next billing date
Wait until the following calendar year
Cancel the current membership entirely first
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到需在下次計費日前至少十個工作天提出變更申請，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "refundable" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第三段中的 "refundable" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "refundable" 指押金「可退還」，與 "returnable" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Travel Expense Reimbursement Form
paragraphs: Use this form to request reimbursement for business travel expenses. Attach original receipts for all expenses over $25; expenses without receipts cannot be reimbursed except for mileage, which is calculated automatically at the standard company rate.

Eligible expenses include airfare, hotel accommodations, ground transportation, and meals up to a daily limit of $60 per employee. Alcohol and entertainment expenses are not reimbursable under company policy and will be deducted from the requested total.

Completed forms must be submitted to the Finance Department within 30 days of the trip's end date. Forms submitted after this window will require additional approval from a department director before processing.
Reimbursements are typically issued within two pay cycles after a completed form is approved.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this form?
questions.question_zh: 這份表格的目的為何?
options: To request reimbursement for business travel expenses
To book a business trip in advance
To report a lost company credit card
To request approval for a new hire's travel
questions.explanation_zh: 表格用於申請出差相關費用的核銷，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the form, what is the daily meal limit per employee?
questions.question_zh: 根據表格內容，每位員工每日餐費的上限為多少?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到每位員工每日餐費上限為 $60，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What happens if a form is submitted after 30 days?
questions.question_zh: 如果表格在30天後才提交，將會發生什麼事?
options: It will require additional approval from a department director
The employee will be charged a penalty fee
It will be processed within one pay cycle
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到逾期提交的表格須經部門主管額外核准，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "issued" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第四段中的 "issued" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "reimbursements are issued" 指款項被「發放、給付」，與 "given out" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Registration Form
paragraphs: Complete this form to register for the third annual Riverbend 5K Fun Run for Literacy, benefiting the Riverbend Community Reading Program.

Registration is $20 per adult and $10 per child under 12 through May 9. Day-of registration will be available at the pavilion beginning at 7:00 a.m. for an additional $5 per person. All registered runners receive a T-shirt and a race bib; T-shirt sizes cannot be guaranteed for day-of registrants.

The race will begin promptly at 8:30 a.m., followed by an awards ceremony and pancake breakfast at 9:30 a.m. Strollers and leashed dogs are welcome on the course, but participants are asked to start toward the back of the group for everyone's safety.
All proceeds will be donated directly to the Riverbend Community Reading Program to purchase books for local elementary schools.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this form?
questions.question_zh: 這份表格的目的為何?
options: To register for a charity fun run
To apply for a volunteer position
To donate books directly to a school
To reserve a spot at a pancake breakfast only
questions.explanation_zh: 表格用於報名參加一場慈善路跑活動，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the form, what time does the race begin?
questions.question_zh: 根據表格內容，比賽於何時開始?
questions.explanation_zh: 第三段提到比賽將準時於上午8:30開始，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why might day-of registrants not receive their preferred T-shirt size?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼當天現場報名的參加者可能無法獲得偏好的T恤尺寸?
options: T-shirts are only given to advance registrants
T-shirt sizes cannot be guaranteed for day-of registrants
Day-of registrants do not receive a T-shirt
All T-shirts are the same size
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段明確提到現場報名者的T恤尺寸無法保證，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "proceeds" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第四段中的 "proceeds" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "all proceeds will be donated" 指活動「所得款項」，與 "earnings raised" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Equipment Service Request Form
paragraphs: Use this form to request repair or maintenance service for shop or office equipment. Submit one form per piece of equipment and include the asset tag number found on the equipment's identification label.

Requests marked "Urgent" will receive a response from the maintenance team within four business hours; requests marked "Standard" are addressed within three business days. Equipment posing an immediate safety hazard should be marked "Urgent" and reported to a supervisor immediately, in addition to submitting this form.

Once a technician has evaluated the equipment, the requester will receive a follow-up notice indicating whether the issue was resolved on-site or whether the equipment must be sent to an outside vendor for repair. Equipment sent off-site is typically unavailable for two to three weeks.
Completed forms should be submitted through the maintenance request portal or left in the maintenance office mailbox on the second floor.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this form?
questions.question_zh: 這份表格的目的為何?
options: To request repair or maintenance service for equipment
To schedule a routine safety inspection
questions.explanation_zh: 表格用於申請設備的維修或保養服務，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: According to the form, how quickly will an "Urgent" request be addressed?
questions.question_zh: 根據表格內容，標示為「緊急」的申請多久內會獲得回應?
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到標示為「緊急」的申請將於四個工作小時內獲得回應，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What should an employee do if equipment poses an immediate safety hazard?
questions.question_zh: 如果設備造成立即的安全危害，員工應該怎麼做?
options: Wait for the standard three-day response
Report it to a supervisor in addition to submitting the form
Ignore it until a technician is available
questions.explanation_zh: 第二段提到有安全危害的設備除填寫表格外，應立即通報主管，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "evaluated" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第三段中的 "evaluated" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思?
questions.explanation_zh: "evaluated the equipment" 指技師「評估、檢查」設備狀況，與 "assessed" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Grand Opening Advertisement
paragraphs: Copper Kettle Bistro invites you to celebrate our grand opening on October 3! Join us for an evening of live jazz music, complimentary appetizers, and a specially priced three-course dinner for $35 per person (regular price $52).

Reservations are recommended, as seating is limited to 60 guests for opening night. Walk-ins will be accommodated only if tables remain available after 7:00 p.m. Parties of six or more should call ahead at least three days in advance.
Doors open at 5:30 p.m., and the last seating is at 9:00 p.m. Complimentary valet parking will be available for the first 40 vehicles.

passages.title: E-mail

meta.label: Subject:
meta.value: Table for Eight on Opening Night

paragraphs: Hello, I saw your advertisement for the grand opening on October 3 and would like to reserve a table for a birthday celebration.

My party will include eight guests in total. I noticed your ad mentions calling ahead for larger groups, so I wanted to first confirm by e-mail that a table for eight would even be available that evening, since seating is limited to 60 guests overall.
We would like to arrive around 6:00 p.m. Could you also let me know whether the $35 dinner special applies to a party our size, or whether it is only offered for smaller tables?
Thank you, and I look forward to your reply. Dana Whitfield

questions.question_en: What is Copper Kettle Bistro celebrating, according to the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，Copper Kettle Bistro 餐廳正在慶祝什麼？
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告開頭明確提到餐廳邀請大家一同慶祝 10 月 3 日的盛大開幕。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, what is the regular price of the three-course dinner?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，三道式套餐的原價是多少？
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告提到特惠價為每人 35 美元，原價則為 52 美元。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, when will walk-in guests be seated?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，未事先預約的客人何時才能入座？
options: Only if tables remain available after 7:00 p.m.
Only with a valet parking ticket
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告說明未預約的客人僅在晚上 7 點後仍有空位時才能入座。

questions.question_en: How many guests will be in Dana's party, according to her e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 根據 Dana 的信件內容，她的聚會共有多少位賓客？
questions.explanation_zh: Dana 在信中提到她的聚會總共有八位賓客。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, why did Dana mention calling ahead in her e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，Dana 為什麼在信中提到要事先致電一事？
options: Because the advertisement states that parties of six or more should call ahead, and her group of eight meets that condition
Because the restaurant does not accept e-mail reservations at all
Because she wants to cancel her reservation
Because the advertisement requires a deposit for all reservations
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件才能回答：廣告提到六人以上的聚會應事先致電，而 Dana 的信件顯示她的聚會共有八人，符合廣告中提到的門檻，因此她才在信中提及此事。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, what is Dana most likely uncertain about regarding her reservation?
questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，Dana 對於她的訂位最可能感到不確定的是什麼？
options: Whether the restaurant offers valet parking
Whether a table for her eight-person party is available given the 60-guest limit and whether the $35 special applies to her group size
Whether the restaurant serves jazz music every night
Whether the restaurant is open on October 3
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件：廣告提到開幕夜僅開放 60 位賓客座位，Dana 的信中則詢問八人的聚會是否能被安排，以及優惠價格是否適用於她的聚會人數，顯示她對這兩點感到不確定。

passages.title: Course Advertisement
paragraphs: Northfield Online Academy is now enrolling for Data Analytics Fundamentals, a six-week self-paced course covering spreadsheet analysis, data visualization, and basic statistics. No prior experience is required.

The course costs $149 and includes lifetime access to all video lectures and downloadable exercise files. Students who complete all twelve modules and pass the final quiz with a score of 70% or higher will receive a certificate of completion.
Enrollment closes on November 15. A 20% early-bird discount is available for anyone who registers before October 20.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Hello,
I'm interested in enrolling in the Data Analytics Fundamentals course before the early-bird deadline, but I have a question about the certificate.
I noticed the course description says a 70% score is needed on the final quiz to earn the certificate. Is there a limit to how many times I can retake the quiz if I don't pass it the first time?
Also, since the course is self-paced, is there a deadline by which I must finish all twelve modules after enrolling, or can I take as long as I like?
Thank you, Marcus Ibe

questions.question_en: How long is the Data Analytics Fundamentals course, according to the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，此資料分析基礎課程的長度為多久？
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告說明此課程為期六週，且為自學進度課程。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, what score is needed on the final quiz to receive a certificate?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，期末測驗需要達到多少分才能取得結業證書？
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告說明學生需在期末測驗達到 70% 以上分數才能取得結業證書。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, what discount is available before October 20?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，10 月 20 日前註冊可享有什麼優惠？
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告提到 10 月 20 日前註冊可享有 20% 的早鳥優惠。

questions.question_en: According to Marcus's e-mail, what does he want to know about the final quiz?
questions.question_zh: 根據 Marcus 的信件內容，他想了解關於期末測驗的什麼資訊？
options: Whether there is a limit on the number of retakes
Whether the quiz counts toward his final grade
Whether the quiz can be taken in person
questions.explanation_zh: Marcus 在信中詢問若第一次未通過測驗，是否有重考次數的限制。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, why is Marcus writing to the academy on October 15?
questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，Marcus 為什麼在 10 月 15 日寫信給學院？
options: Because he wants to enroll before the October 20 early-bird deadline mentioned in the advertisement, and has questions before doing so
Because the course has already sold out
Because he wants to request a full refund
Because the advertisement listed the wrong price
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件才能回答：廣告提到 10 月 20 日前註冊享有早鳥優惠，而 Marcus 的信件日期為 10 月 15 日，顯示他是想在優惠截止前完成註冊，因此先詢問相關細節。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, which piece of information from the advertisement most directly prompted Marcus's second question?
questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，廣告中的哪項資訊最直接促使 Marcus 提出他的第二個問題？
options: The fact that the course is self-paced, which led him to ask whether there is still a completion deadline
The fact that the course includes downloadable exercise files
The fact that the course costs $149
The fact that the course covers basic statistics
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件：廣告提到課程為自學進度制，Marcus 因此在信中詢問是否仍有完成所有課程模組的期限。

passages.title: Membership Promotion
paragraphs: Ironview Fitness Center is offering a New Member Special: sign up for a 12-month membership this month and receive the first two months free, plus a complimentary personal training session.

The promotion applies only to memberships purchased in person at the front desk or by phone; online sign-ups are not eligible for the free personal training session, though they still receive the two free months.
Members who sign up under this promotion must maintain their membership for a minimum of six months, or an early-cancellation fee of $75 will apply.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Ms. Cole,
Thank you for signing up for a 12-month membership online through our website today. Your first payment will be processed on November 1, after your two free promotional months.

We noticed your sign-up was completed through our website. Please note that the complimentary personal training session mentioned in some of our advertising is available only to members who register in person or over the phone, so this session has not been added to your account.
If you would still like to schedule a personal training session, please visit the front desk and we would be happy to add it for a discounted rate.
Welcome to Ironview Fitness Center! Front Desk Team

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, what do new members receive with a 12-month membership this month?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，本月申辦 12 個月會籍的新會員可獲得什麼？
options: The first two months free plus a complimentary personal training session
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告提到本月申辦 12 個月會籍者，可獲得前兩個月免費以及一堂免費的私人教練課程。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, what happens if a member cancels before six months?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，若會員在六個月內取消會籍會發生什麼事？
options: Nothing, cancellation is free at any time
The member loses access immediately with no fee
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告說明若在六個月內提前取消會籍，須支付 75 美元的提前取消手續費。

questions.question_en: According to the e-mail, how did Renata sign up for her membership?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，Renata 是透過什麼方式申辦會籍的？
options: In person at the front desk
questions.explanation_zh: 信件中提到 Renata 是透過官網完成線上申辦。

questions.question_en: According to the e-mail, when will Renata's first payment be processed?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，Renata 的第一筆費用將於何時扣款？
questions.explanation_zh: 信件提到在兩個月的優惠免費期結束後，第一筆費用將於 11 月 1 日扣款。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, why did Renata not receive a complimentary personal training session?
questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，Renata 為什麼沒有獲得免費的私人教練課程？
options: Because the advertisement states the free session applies only to in-person or phone sign-ups, and Renata signed up online
Because she canceled her membership early
Because the promotion had already ended by the time she signed up
Because she requested a refund instead
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件才能回答：廣告說明免費私人教練課程僅適用於臨櫃或電話申辦的會員，而信件顯示 Renata 是透過網站線上申辦，因此不符合此優惠資格。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, what benefit will Renata still receive despite signing up online?
questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，儘管 Renata 是透過線上申辦，她仍會獲得哪項優惠？
options: A free upgrade to a 24-month plan

passages.title: Office Relocation Notice
paragraphs: Please be advised that all staff currently located on the 3rd floor of the Denton Street building will relocate to the new office at 88 Harborview Plaza, 6th Floor, effective November 4.
Moving crews will pack and transport desk items on November 1 and 2. Employees should remove personal items from drawers and label boxes with their name and new desk number by end of day October 31.

The new building offers underground parking for a monthly fee of $60, which is $20 more than our current arrangement. Employees who wish to reserve a spot should contact Facilities Management by October 25, as spaces are limited to 50.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Hi,
I read the notice about our move to Harborview Plaza and wanted to ask about parking before the reservation deadline.

I currently pay $40 per month for parking at the Denton Street building. Since the notice mentions the new rate will be $20 more, I want to confirm the new monthly cost before I decide whether to reserve a spot.
Also, since spaces are limited to 50, could you tell me how many employees have already reserved a spot, so I know whether I should register soon?
Thanks, Owen Bryant

questions.question_en: According to the notice, when will the relocation take effect?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告內容，遷移生效日期為何時？
questions.explanation_zh: 公告說明遷移生效日期為 11 月 4 日。

questions.question_en: According to the notice, what should employees do by October 31?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告內容，員工應在 10 月 31 日前完成什麼事？
options: Remove personal items from drawers and label boxes
questions.explanation_zh: 公告要求員工在 10 月 31 日前清空抽屜個人物品並在箱子上標示姓名與新座位號碼。

questions.question_en: According to the notice, how many parking spaces are available at the new building?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告內容，新大樓提供多少個停車位？
questions.explanation_zh: 公告說明新大樓的地下停車位數量限 50 個。

questions.question_en: According to Owen's e-mail, how much does he currently pay for parking?
questions.question_zh: 根據 Owen 的信件內容，他目前每月支付多少停車費？
questions.explanation_zh: Owen 在信中提到他目前每月支付 40 美元的停車費。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, what will Owen's new monthly parking cost be if he reserves a spot?
questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，如果 Owen 預約車位，他每月的新停車費用會是多少？
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件才能回答：公告說明新大樓停車費為每月 60 美元，比現行方案多 20 美元；Owen 的信件提到他目前支付 40 美元，兩者相加可推算新費用為 60 美元，這也與公告直接吻合。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, why is Owen concerned about registering soon?
questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，Owen 為什麼擔心需要盡快登記？
options: Because the notice states parking spaces are limited to 50 and the reservation deadline is approaching, so he wants to know how many spots remain before deciding
Because he has already missed the relocation date
Because he wants to cancel his current parking arrangement immediately
Because the notice states the new building has no parking at all
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件：公告提到車位僅限 50 個且須在 10 月 25 日前登記，Owen 的信件顯示他因此想先了解已有多少人登記，以判斷是否該盡快申請。

passages.title: Library Closure Notice
paragraphs: Fernwood Public Library will be closed to the public from October 6 through October 20 for roof renovation work. The building will reopen for normal hours on October 21.
During the closure, the outdoor book drop on the north side of the building will remain open 24 hours a day for returns. No late fees will be charged for items due during the closure period.

Patrons with holds waiting for pickup will have their pickup deadline automatically extended until November 3. Please note that the library's computer lab and meeting rooms will not be accessible until reopening.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Hello,
I have a book that was due back on October 8, right in the middle of your renovation closure. I still have the book at home and won't be able to visit until the library reopens.
I saw a sign on the front door mentioning the closure, but I wasn't sure whether the book drop is still open, since the doors themselves are locked. Could you confirm?
I'm also holding a copy of a novel I placed on hold before the closure. Since I can't pick it up right now, will I lose my place in line?
Thank you, Isla Hartman

questions.explanation_zh: 公告說明圖書館因屋頂整修工程而暫停開放。

questions.question_en: According to Isla's e-mail, when was her book originally due?

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, will Isla be charged a late fee for her overdue book?

options: Yes, because the book was already overdue before the closure began
No, because the notice states no late fees apply to items due during the closure period
Yes, but only half the usual fee
No, but only if she returns it within 24 hours of reopening
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件才能回答：公告說明關閉期間到期的書籍不會被收取滯納金，而 Isla 的信件顯示她的書正好在 10 月 8 日到期，落在關閉期間內，因此不會產生滯納金。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, does Isla need to worry about losing her place in line for her held novel?
questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，Isla 是否需要擔心失去她預約書籍的排隊順位？
options: Yes, because holds are canceled automatically during any closure

Yes, because the book drop is closed during renovation

questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件：公告說明所有預約取書的期限已自動延長至 11 月 3 日，而 Isla 的信件詢問她是否會失去排隊順位，依公告內容她不需擔心此問題。

passages.title: Pool Maintenance Notice
paragraphs: The community pool will be closed from September 30 through October 2 for annual filtration system maintenance. The pool will reopen at 8:00 a.m. on October 3.
During this time, the pool deck and surrounding lounge area will also be closed, but the adjacent fitness room will remain open on its normal schedule.

Residents who have reserved the pool area for private events during this period should contact the management office to reschedule. No refunds will be issued for cleaning fee deposits already paid, but deposits will be applied to the rescheduled date.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Mr. Alvarez,

We are writing regarding your reservation of the pool area for a private gathering on October 1. As you may have seen in our recent notice, the pool will be undergoing maintenance from September 30 through October 2.
Since your event falls within this closure period, we will need to reschedule it. We have availability on October 8 or October 15; please let us know which date works better for you.
Your $50 cleaning fee deposit will be automatically applied to whichever new date you choose, so there is no need to submit payment again.
We apologize for the inconvenience. Property Management

questions.explanation_zh: 信件提到 Teo Alvarez 預約泳池是為了舉辦私人聚會。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, why does Teo Alvarez's reservation need to be rescheduled?

options: Because his original date, October 1, falls within the pool closure period stated in the notice
Because he failed to pay his cleaning deposit on time
Because the fitness room is also closed on that date
Because he requested a different date himself
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件才能回答：公告說明泳池將於 9 月 30 日至 10 月 2 日關閉，而信件顯示 Teo Alvarez 原訂的活動日期為 10 月 1 日，正好落在關閉期間，因此必須改期。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, does Teo Alvarez need to pay an additional fee to reschedule his event?
questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，Teo Alvarez 若改期舉辦活動，是否需要額外支付費用？
options: Yes, a new $50 deposit is required for the new date
No, because his existing deposit will be applied to whichever new date he selects

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Hi Colin,
Just a reminder that the registration deadline for the Regional Sales Conference in Denver is August 20. The early registration fee is $320, but after August 20 it increases to $420.
I already registered and booked my flight for the morning of September 14, arriving the day before the conference starts on September 15. The conference runs through September 17.
Our travel budget covers registration, flights, and up to three nights of hotel per person. Let me know if you're planning to attend so I can let Accounting know how many of us are going.
Thanks, Yuki

questions.explanation_zh: Colin 在信中說明他想提早一天抵達，以便在會議開始前拜訪一位客戶。

questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，Colin 會在早鳥優惠截止日期前還是之後完成註冊？
options: Before, since he plans to register today, which is before the August 20 deadline Yuki mentioned
After, since he missed the deadline
He does not plan to register at all
The documents do not specify a deadline
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件才能回答：Yuki 的信中提到早鳥註冊截止日為 8 月 20 日，Colin 的回信日期是 8 月 13 日，且他表示要今天就完成註冊以把握 320 美元的早鳥價，顯示他會在截止日前完成註冊。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, why is Colin unsure whether his hotel stay will be fully covered?
questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，Colin 為什麼不確定他的住宿費用是否會全額報銷？

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: To Whom It May Concern,
I ordered the 10-piece nonstick cookware set (Order #58213) on June 28, and it arrived on July 4 with a large dent in the lid of the largest pot. The rest of the set appears undamaged.
I would like to request a replacement lid rather than returning the entire set, since I only received one damaged piece. Please let me know if this is possible and what steps I need to take.
I have attached photos of the damage to this e-mail. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.
Regards, Beatrix Solano

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Ms. Solano,
Thank you for reaching out, and we're sorry to hear about the damage to your order. We received your photos, and unfortunately, we do not sell individual lids separately from a full set.

However, since your order was received within seven days of delivery and the item was damaged in transit, we can offer you a full replacement set at no additional cost, or a full refund if you prefer not to receive a replacement.

If you would like the replacement set, please reply within five business days, and we will ship it within 48 hours of your response. If we do not hear from you within that time, we will process a refund automatically.
Sincerely, Customer Care Team

The lid of the largest pot
questions.explanation_zh: Beatrix 在信中提到最大的鍋子的鍋蓋有一處明顯凹陷。

Because the order was placed too long ago
questions.explanation_zh: 公司回覆信中說明鍋蓋並不單獨販售，僅隨整組鍋具出售。

questions.question_en: According to the company's reply, what will happen if Beatrix does not respond within five business days?
questions.question_zh: 根據公司回覆信件，若 Beatrix 未在五個工作天內回覆，會發生什麼事？
options: A refund will be processed automatically
A replacement lid will be mailed to her
questions.explanation_zh: 公司回覆信中說明若五個工作天內未收到回覆，將自動為她辦理退款。

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, what solution did the company offer instead of Beatrix's original request?
questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，公司提供了什麼替代方案來取代 Beatrix 原本的要求？
options: A full replacement set at no cost, or a full refund
A 50% discount on a future order
A store credit equal to double the order value
A repair kit mailed to her home

questions.question_zh: 綜合兩篇文件，為什麼 Beatrix 有資格獲得免費更換，而不需自行付費？
options: Because her order was received within seven days of delivery and was damaged in transit, as stated in the company's policy
Because she is a long-time loyal customer
Because she paid for expedited shipping
Because the company made an error in the original order

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: Introducing the SonicWave Pro Earbuds: crisp sound, active noise cancellation, and a compact charging case that adds three extra full charges on the go. Battery life is up to 8 hours per charge, or 32 hours total with the case.
Available in black, white, and sage green for $89. Each pair includes three sizes of ear tips for a customized fit and is rated IPX4 for splash resistance during workouts.
Order by 3:00 p.m. for same-day shipping. All orders include a 30-day return window; earbuds must be returned in original packaging with all accessories.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Hello,
I'm interested in ordering the SonicWave Pro Earbuds in sage green, but I have a couple of questions first.
The ad says the earbuds are IPX4 rated, but I run outdoors in fairly heavy rain sometimes. Would that level of water resistance be enough to protect them, or should I look at a different model?
Also, if I decide the fit isn't right for me, does the 30-day return window start from the order date or the delivery date?
Thank you, Nadia Fekete

passages.title: E-mail

meta.label: Subject:
meta.value: RE: Questions Before Ordering SonicWave Pro

paragraphs: Dear Ms. Fekete,

Thank you for your interest in the SonicWave Pro Earbuds. IPX4 rating means the earbuds can handle light splashes and sweat, but they are not designed for heavy or prolonged rain exposure. For your use case, we'd recommend our SonicWave Trail model instead, which is rated IPX7 for full submersion resistance.
To answer your second question, the 30-day return window begins on the delivery date, not the order date, so you'll have the full 30 days from when the package arrives at your address.
Please let us know if you'd like us to help you place an order for either model.
Best regards, SonicWave Audio Support

passages.title: System Upgrade Notice
paragraphs: The IT Department will perform a scheduled system upgrade this weekend. Email, shared network drives, and the timesheet portal will be unavailable from Saturday at 11:00 p.m. until Sunday at 5:00 a.m.
All other systems, including the customer database and the internal messaging app, will remain accessible throughout the maintenance window.

Employees who need to submit timesheets before the weekend should do so by Friday at 5:00 p.m. Any timesheets not submitted by then can be entered after the system is restored Sunday morning, with no penalty for late entries caused by the maintenance window.

Will I be marked late if I submit it Monday morning instead, after the maintenance window ends?
Also, will I still be able to use the internal messaging app this weekend if I need to reach a colleague, or is that affected by the upgrade too?
Thanks, Gemma

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Hi Gemma,

Thanks for checking in. Since the timesheet portal will already be back online by the time you return on Monday, you're welcome to submit your timesheet then. As stated in our notice, late entries caused by the maintenance window carry no penalty, so there's nothing to worry about.
As for the messaging app, that system is not part of this weekend's maintenance, so you'll be able to use it normally to reach your colleague.
Let us know if you run into any other issues.
IT Help Desk

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, what is the base rate for moves under 100 miles?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，未滿 100 英里的搬家基本費率是多少？
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告說明未滿 100 英里的搬家基本費率為每磅 0.80 美元。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, how much does temporary storage cost per month?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，臨時倉儲每月費用是多少？
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告說明臨時倉儲每月費用為 60 美元，但搭配全套搬家服務可享 30 天免費。

questions.question_en: According to Priyansh's e-mail, approximately how far is his move?
questions.question_zh: 根據 Priyansh 的信件內容，他的搬家距離大約是多遠？
questions.explanation_zh: Priyansh 在信中提到他的搬家距離約為 12 英里，屬於同城搬遷。

questions.question_en: According to Priyansh's e-mail, how long does he estimate he will need storage?
questions.question_zh: 根據 Priyansh 的信件內容，他預估需要多久的倉儲時間？
questions.explanation_zh: Priyansh 在信中提到他大約需要三週的倉儲時間。

questions.question_en: Based on the advertisement and the company's reply, how was Priyansh's total moving cost of $3,200 calculated?
questions.question_zh: 綜合廣告與公司回覆信件，Priyansh 的搬家總費用 3,200 美元是如何計算出來的？
options: By multiplying his estimated 4,000-pound weight by the advertised $0.80 per pound local rate
By using the long-distance mileage rate
By adding a flat storage fee to the base rate
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考廣告與公司回覆信件：廣告列出未滿 100 英里的費率為每磅 0.80 美元，回覆信則以 Priyansh 信中提到的 4,000 磅重量乘以此費率，計算出總費用為 3,200 美元。

questions.question_en: Based on Priyansh's e-mail and the company's reply, will he be charged for his storage needs?
questions.question_zh: 綜合 Priyansh 的信件與公司回覆信件，他的倉儲需求是否需要額外付費？
options: Yes, because his need exceeds the free storage limit
No, because his three-week storage need falls within the 30-day free period offered with a full-service move
Yes, at the standard $60 monthly rate
No, because storage is always free regardless of move type
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考 Priyansh 的信件與公司回覆信：Priyansh 詢問三週倉儲是否落在免費期間內，回覆信確認他的三週（21 天）需求完全在 30 天免費期限內，只要訂購全套搬家服務即可免費使用。

questions.question_en: Based on all three documents, which advertised condition determined that Priyansh would NOT be charged the $150 minimum fee?
questions.question_zh: 綜合三篇文件，廣告中的哪項條件決定了 Priyansh 不會被收取 150 美元的最低收費？
options: The fact that his calculated cost based on weight and distance already exceeded the $150 minimum
The fact that he booked storage along with his move
The fact that his move was local rather than long-distance
The fact that he requested a free online estimate first
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考三篇文件：廣告說明未滿 100 英里的搬家設有 150 美元最低收費，Priyansh 的信件提供了重量與距離資訊，公司回覆信計算出的 3,200 美元已遠超過此最低收費門檻，因此最低收費規定對他不適用。
